description: This file defines the 'ChatConnection' class, which manages peer-to-peer chat connectivity over TCP sockets using Android's networking APIs. It includes inner classes 'ChatServer' for accepting incoming connections and 'ChatClient' for outbound connections, handling message sending and receiving, and maintaining socket lifecycle management.

classes.name: ChatConnection
classes.description: Main class for managing chat connections, including server and client-side socket handling, message exchange, and connection teardown.

classes.name: ChatConnection.ChatServer
classes.description: Handles server-side socket acceptance; runs in a separate thread to listen for incoming client connections.

classes.name: ChatConnection.ChatServer.ServerThread
classes.description: Runnable that creates server socket, accepts incoming connections, and manages connected client sockets.

classes.name: ChatConnection.ChatClient
classes.description: Handles client-side connection to a remote server, enabling message sending and receiving over a socket.

classes.name: ChatConnection.ChatClient.SendingThread
classes.description: Runnable for queuing and sending messages over the socket.

classes.name: ChatConnection.ChatClient.ReceivingThread
classes.description: Runnable for reading incoming messages from the socket and updating the UI.

methods.name: ChatConnection(Handler handler)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the connection with a message handler.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Stops server and client threads, closing sockets.

methods.name: connectToServer(InetAddress address, int port)
methods.description: Initiates connection to a remote server.

methods.name: sendMessage(String msg)
methods.description: Sends a chat message via the client socket.

methods.name: getLocalPort
methods.description: Returns the local port number on which the server socket is listening.

methods.name: updateMessages(String msg, boolean local)
methods.description: Updates UI with new message, marking as sent or received.

methods.name: setSocket(Socket socket)
methods.description: Sets the current socket, closing existing one if necessary.

methods.name: ChatServer()
methods.description: Constructor that starts server thread for accepting incoming connections.

methods.name: tearDown()
methods.description: Stops the server thread and closes server socket.

methods.name: run()
methods.description: Main server thread logic: creating server socket, accepting clients, and establishing connection.

methods.name: ChatClient()
methods.description: Constructor that initiates connection to remote server and starts message sending thread.

methods.name: sendMessage(String msg)
methods.description: Sends a message over the socket.

methods.name: run() in SendingThread
methods.description: Initializes socket if null, starts receiving thread, and sends queued messages.

methods.name: run() in ReceivingThread
methods.description: Reads messages from input stream and updates UI.
